name: P-chloroamphetamine
summary: para-Chloroamphetamine (PCA), also known as 4-chloroamphetamine (4-CA), is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) and serotonergic neurotoxin of the amphetamine family.

pharmacology.text: para-Chloroamphetamine (PCA), also known as 4-chloroamphetamine (4-CA), is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) and serotonergic neurotoxin of the amphetamine family.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Serotonergic neurotoxin; Antidepressant; Stimulant

uses.text: It is used in scientific research in the study of the serotonin system, as a serotonin releasing agent (SRA) at lower doses to produce serotonergic effects, and as a serotonergic neurotoxin at higher doses to produce long-lasting depletions of serotonin. PCA has also been clinically studied as an appetite suppressant and antidepressant, but findings of neurotoxicity in animals discouraged further evaluation.

summaryZh: 4-氯苯丙胺（對氯苯丙胺，4-CA、PCA）是一種血清素-去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺釋放劑，也是苯丙胺類化合物中的血清素活性神經毒素。它可由4-氯苯基丙酮、乙酸銨和氰基硼氫化鈉在甲醇中反應製得。
